20	def is_night_from_time(value):
21	    parts = value.split(":")
22	    if len(parts) != 2 or not all(part.isdigit() for part in parts):
23	        fail("time", value)
24	    hour, minute = map(int, parts)
25	    if hour < 0 or hour > 23 or minute < 0 or minute > 59:
26	        fail("time", value)
27	    return hour >= 23 or hour < 6

34	    group.add_argument("--night", metavar="STATUS")
